headline: Names a Port Hueneme, California Postal Service building the "Seabees Fallen Heroes Post Office Building."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 560 East Pleasant Valley Road in Port Hueneme, California, an official honorary name. The name honors the Navy's Construction Battalions, known as the Seabees, and their fallen members. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
